title: Li-Mohanram (2014) mechanical earnings forecasts - free EDGAR point-in-time panel, FY1-FY3 validation
authority: Owner directive 2026-08-07 (FENO RIM RECOVERY) sections 5-6 and 14. DEC-291. Public surface stays KEEP_QUARANTINED.
independent_red_team: cc (Claude Code) - pre-review window open BEFORE any run this time (charter follows this freeze)

literature_anchor.paper: Li, K.K. & Mohanram, P.S. (2014). Evaluating cross-sectional forecasting models for implied cost of capital. Review of Accounting Studies 19, 1152-1185. DOI 10.1007/s11142-014-9282-y
literature_anchor.local_copy: data/edgar/literature/li-mohanram-2014-rast.pdf (+ .txt extraction) - downloaded 2026-08-07 from the authors' Rotman page
literature_anchor.spec_source: Equations (2),(3),(7), Section 3.2, Appendix A of the paper, read line-by-line from the local text extraction. Every deviation below is declared.

models_frozen.EP: eps(t+tau) = b0 + b1*NegE_t + b2*eps_t + b3*(NegE_t * eps_t) + e. Per-share level (all variables divided by shares outstanding of year t). Baseline 2.
models_frozen.RI: eps(t+tau) = c0 + c1*NegE_t + c2*eps_t + c3*(NegE_t * eps_t) + c4*bps_t + c5*tacc_t + e. Per-share level. Primary model.
models_frozen.expected_signs: RI: c2>0, c4>0, c3<0, c5<0 (paper section 2.4). Reported, not enforced.
models_frozen.hvz_note: HVZ (Eq. 1) is NOT implemented - the owner directive names RW and EP as the R1 baselines. Declared deviation, no action.
models_frozen.estimation: Pooled cross-sectional OLS, separate regression per tau in {1,2,3}. Training window for forecast-as-of June 30 of year Y: tau=1 uses fiscal years Y-10..Y-1, tau=2 uses Y-11..Y-2, tau=3 uses Y-12..Y-3 (paper section 3.2). Firm-year rows enter the pool when all regressors are available; forecast requires only non-missing regressors at year t (paper). Missing TACC set to zero with a flag (paper).
models_frozen.fye_rule: Paper: at June 30 of year Y, firms with fiscal-year-end April-June do not yet have year-Y-eligible financials; only FYE April_{Y-1}..March_Y counts as 'year t'. Implemented: for origin June 30 of Y, a firm's year t = latest fiscal year with period_end <= June 30 of Y AND filed <= June 30 of Y, EXCEPT FYE in {04,05,06} which must use the prior fiscal year. Declared: this shifts those firms' information back one year, matching the paper's look-ahead guard.
models_frozen.winsorization: All continuous regression variables (eps, bps, tacc, and dependent eps at t+tau) winsorized annually at 1st/99th percentiles within each fiscal year, matching the paper. Winsorization boundaries computed per fiscal year from the estimation pool only.

earnings_E.paper: IB - SPI (income before extraordinary items minus special items), Compustat
earnings_E.edgar_primary: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsNetOfTaxAttributableToReportingEntity (closest free analog of earnings before extraordinary items)
earnings_E.edgar_fallback: us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss when primary absent for that firm-year; which source was used is recorded per firm-year
earnings_E.declared_deviation: Special items (SPI) are not separable from EDGAR XBRL consistently; E is therefore earnings-before-extraordinary-items, not net of special items. Disclosed in the validation artifact.

variable_definitions_edgar_mapping.book_B: us-gaap:StockholdersEquity minus us-gaap:PreferredStockValue (preferred missing treated as 0) = common equity, / shares

tacc_components.IVAO: us-gaap:OtherNoncurrentAssets as proxy, else 0 (declared: Compustat IVAO has no exact EDGAR analog; appears in NCO with minus and FIN with plus, so partial cancellation limits the proxy damage)
tacc_components.TACC: (dWC + dNCO + dFIN) / CSHOT_t, changes from fiscal t-1 to t; missing => 0 flagged (paper)

variable_definitions_edgar_mapping.fact_selection: Annual facts only: form in {10-K, 10-K/A}, fp=FY. Point-in-time rule identical to the e2 basket panel (cleared clean by red team in R0): facts with filed <= reference date, earliest filed per period.

universe_precommitted.definition: Current S&P 500 membership per data/slickcharts/sp500.json (snapshot 2026-08-02, 503 holdings) UNION the 30 rim-dow symbols. Common stocks only; ADR/ETF excluded by construction of both lists.
universe_precommitted.symbol_to_cik: data/edgar/company_tickers.json; unmatched symbols dropped and listed in the artifact
universe_precommitted.sic_industry: SEC cik-ticker-sic.json fetched once; used only for industry-bucket reporting (10 SIC groups)
universe_precommitted.survivorship_bound: Current membership applied to all sample years; additions after 2009 (e.g. names joining S&P500 post-2015) enter early years as if members. Bias common to all three models (same firms, same origins) so within-model comparison is valid; external validity bounded. Stated in the validation artifact, same pattern as R0.
universe_precommitted.minimum_pool_size: A (tau, origin) forecast is produced only if its pooled training window has >= 300 firm-year rows; below that the origin is voided and recorded. Paper pools are ~4000+; 300 is a floor against degenerate fits, not a tuning knob.
universe_precommitted.financials_included: All industries included (paper covers full Compustat); no sector exclusion. Declared per owner directive 5.2.

sample_precommitted.horizons: tau in {1,2,3} per owner directive; the paper estimates to tau=5 but R2 consumes FY1-FY3 only (FL3 three-period structure)
sample_precommitted.evaluation_actuals: tau=1..3 evaluated where the realized fiscal year t+tau has a filed annual fact by 2026-08-07 (data cutoff). Origin 2023 tau=3 (fiscal 2026 results) expected mostly unfiled - evaluated on available actuals only, counts reported. No imputation of missing actuals.
sample_precommitted.xbirl_coverage_note: EDGAR XBRL coverage is dense from ~FY2009; training windows for origin 2019 start at FY2009 (tau=1: 2009..2018). Pre-2009 years contribute little; pool construction does not reach before FY2005 in any window. Declared.

price_source_for_error_scaling.source: Stooq daily closes (repo precedent: macro-chart stooq loader), https://stooq.com/q/d/l/?s={sym}.us&i=d, fetched once per symbol
price_source_for_error_scaling.scaling: Forecast error scaled by the last close on or before June 30 of the origin year (tolerance 10 trading days), matching the paper's end-of-June price scaling for per-share models. Symbols without a price are excluded from price-scaled metrics and counted.
price_source_for_error_scaling.fallback: If Stooq is unreachable for a symbol, that symbol drops from price-scaled metrics (reported); no alternate source substitution after results.

metrics_per_tau: share of loss firms in sample
buckets: size terciles by total assets (declared proxy for market cap)
validation_design.comparisons: RI vs RW, RI vs EP, EP vs RW, on each metric and bucket

necessary_and_sufficient_declared.necessary_to_proceed_to_R2: RI price-scaled MAE < RW price-scaled MAE at BOTH tau=1 and tau=2 on the full sample (paper's own bar is beating the naive benchmark; tau=3 reported but not gating because its actuals are the thinnest)
necessary_and_sufficient_declared.sufficient_to_proceed_to_R2: the necessary condition alone. EP/RW comparison is sanity of the pooled design, not a gate.
necessary_and_sufficient_declared.model_selection_for_R2_input: pre-committed: whichever of RI and EP has LOWER average price-scaled MAE across tau=1..3 becomes the R2 forecast input; the other is carried as sensitivity. Chosen by this rule, not by judgment after results.
necessary_and_sufficient_declared.no_veto_legs: Per red-team ask (fh-20260807-023): no additional leg can veto the gate. Extra statistics are reported as diagnostics only and listed as such.

validation_design.coefficient_diagnostics: Per-tau pooled coefficients with OLS se, compared to expected signs; sign inversions reported, not gated.
validation_design.if_ri_fails_rw: Per owner directive: stop, do not proceed to R2 with these forecasts, report the cause. The recovery continues to the data decision (C) or retirement (D) on that evidence.

prohibitions: No universe, window, metric, scaling, or source change after results are observed.
No paid data, no account creation, no login (owner directive section 3 and 8).
No Oracle data in the deployable path.
No public number republication; quarantine untouched.
Criteria and receipt commit in a separate earlier commit than any result.
